school.school_name: 上尾中央看護専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify the official-index disclosure site finds the likely confirmation-form PDF, but does not auto-accept it without FY2026 evidence.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the admission support page and inspect the anchor labeled 確認申請.
Classify it as a target-looking PDF requiring operator/OCR review because neither the URL, anchor, nor extracted PDF text proves FY2026.

reusable_rules: Keep anchors labeled 確認申請 as strong target-form candidates even when the link text omits the fiscal year.
Route target-looking PDFs with no URL, anchor, or PDF-body fiscal-year evidence to needs_operator_review.
Preserve the evidence URL so the operator can decide whether OCR or manual PDF inspection proves the target year.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-accept a yearless confirmation-form candidate as FY2026.
Do not discard the PDF as non-target only because the surrounding support page also links many news/common PDFs.
Do not infer FY2026 from the current crawl date.

evidence.notes: Windows v150 Saitama 51-site replay produced target_fiscal_year_not_detected for school_id 757 with pdf_type=target and anchor 確認申請.
